input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone—nothing less will do. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need my mobile data to work perfectly.
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next to get my internet speed fixed.
I definitely don’t want to change my plan, but I’m willing to refuel. Please add 2GB of data to my account so I can get back to excellent internet speed. What do I need to do next?
I just tried to check my internet speed, but it looks like there’s still no connection at all. My mobile data isn’t working even after the refuel. What should I do next?
My status bar shows that Airplane Mode is enabled, and I don’t see any signal bars or mobile data icons like 4G, LTE, or 5G. What should I do next?

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now I see one bar of signal (poor), it says 2G, and mobile data is enabled. However, I also notice that Data Saver is on. What should I do next? My internet still isn’t working properly.

I turned off Data Saver mode and set my network preference to 4G/5G. Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength and 5G, but when I try to run a speed test, it still says there’s no connection. What should I do next? This is getting frustrating—I really need excellent internet speed.

My SIM card is active and working, and my APN settings show the APN name as "internet" with the MMSC URL set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc". Nothing seems to be missing or obviously incorrect. What should I try next?

I restarted my phone, and my status bar still shows excellent 5G signal with data enabled. However, when I try to use the internet or run a speed test, it still says there’s no connection. What else can we try? I really need to get excellent internet speed working.

Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. The internet is either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone—nothing less will do. Can you help me fix this? I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need my mobile data to work perfectly.

To help you with your mobile data issue, I’ll need to identify your account first. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth (in YYYY-MM-DD format), or
- Your customer ID (if you have it)?

Once I have this information, I can begin troubleshooting your mobile data problem.

I just tried to check my internet speed, but it looks like there’s still no connection at all. My mobile data isn’t working even after the refuel. What should I do next?

Let’s troubleshoot your mobile data connection step by step. I’ll guide you through some checks and actions on your phone to identify and fix the issue.

First, please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- Do you see any signal bars?
- Is there an icon for mobile data (like 4G, LTE, 5G)?
- Is Airplane Mode enabled?

If you’re not sure, I can walk you through how to check these. Let me know what you see, or if you need instructions.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. This will re-enable your cellular connection and allow your phone to access mobile data.

Once you’ve turned off Airplane Mode, check if you see signal bars and a mobile data icon (such as 4G, LTE, or 5G) in your status bar. Let me know if your internet starts working or if you still have issues after turning off Airplane Mode.

Here’s what you should do next to improve your mobile data connection:

1. Turn off Data Saver mode on your phone. This can restrict your data usage and slow down or block internet access.
2. Change your network mode preference to allow 4G or 5G, since 2G is too slow for reliable internet.

Since both appear correct and your phone shows excellent 5G signal, but you still have no internet connection, the next step is to reboot your device. This will refresh all network settings and connections, which often resolves lingering connectivity issues after changes.

Please restart your phone now. After it powers back on, try using your mobile data again and let me know if your internet connection is restored. If it’s still not working, I’ll continue to help you troubleshoot.

- Data enabled,

and you still have no internet connection, this may indicate a deeper technical issue with your line or account that cannot be resolved through standard troubleshooting.
